scientific_integrity: Arithmetic field and reduction theorem supported by explicit eliminations, smoothness determinant, third-component nonvanishing norms, exact Galois fixed-point computations and quadratic Chebotarev. All standard-library code and source citations are included; independent review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed rational union of three hyperosculating conics; geometric twelve-node count is known. Arithmetic classification excludes characteristics 2 and 3; singularity types of exceptional reductions at 7 and 13 are not fully classified. The twenty-prime computer census is a cross-check, not proof of infinitude; bibliographic coverage is not exhaustive.
title: Arithmetic Galois splitting and exceptional reductions of three nodal-cubic osculating conics
